report:
Initial stage: its source membership and distinct snapshot were not supplied, so a separate diagnosis or stage-to-stage change cannot be reconstructed. Updated stage: the complete supplied focal set supports repeated reported Super Saturated (SS) hydration, with mixed texture experiences. A07 remains unavailable testimony after retrieval: its entire text is “undefined...”.

SS hydration is directly reported by three credited retailer accounts: A04 describes lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying hydration before makeup without perceived pore clogging; A08 reports hydration alongside tretinoin and other actives at age 51; A13 describes retention through a 12-hour shift with oily T-zone, dry sensitive cheeks and mild rosacea. Their shared hydration proposition is independently repeated within retailer reviews, not cross-venue corroborated. A13’s duration, reduced oil, irritation and congestion claims remain individual details. No direct SS hydration opposition appears in the usable focal evidence; this does not establish universal effectiveness or standalone causation. A09 separately reports Avant Guard plus SS retaining hydration, with no separable allocation and a small-head/nose fit complaint costing one star.

Three focal accounts directly describe SS texture. A03 finds Wave less sticky but continues SS for its presumed greater glycerin content; that comparative result is one account with independence unavailable. A13 reports sticky, shiny, slick feel, recommends small amounts/daytime caution and continues enthusiastic use. These provide convergent stickiness descriptions across community and retailer roles, but the supplied independence limitation prevents firm cross-venue promotion. A04’s lightweight, fast-drying experience makes the overall texture finding mixed/conditional; dose, routine, skin and version differences are not established explanations. A17 has never used Experiment and merely infers that Wave is thinner from stated glycerin percentages; this cannot corroborate experienced SS texture or hydration. Formula versions remain unknown throughout; A04’s Refill and A08’s First Time metadata identify targets, not formula changes or independently narrated repurchases.

Other-product testimony must stay product-specific. A10’s overnight retention/glow is Buffer Jelly, with SS unnamed. A14’s gifted Buffer Jelly, used twice with moisturizer, gives silky jelly-to-oil slip and soft, less red skin; it does not establish SS texture. A15 praises Plasma Wash silkiness but reports inadequate cleansing, eye burning and increased dryness, considering a return without reporting one. This conflicts with A04’s favorable face-wash hydration/cleansing account, not with SS hydration. A18 praises Wave hydration but reports C.R.E.A.M overnight moisture loss and sunscreen pilling; A17 supplies related C.R.E.A.M concerns and a Wave-mixing workaround. These concern other products, not SS failures or comparative SS hydration superiority.

Explicit consequences: A04 narrates ordering SS after introduction by a sister, then buying Buffer Jelly for greater nighttime hydration/repair, followed by face wash and mesh moisturizer purchases. This is one person’s reported sequence, not proof hydration caused all purchases. A03 retains SS despite relative stickiness; A13 remains enthusiastic despite sticky feel. A14 declares conversion, with future dermaplaning use speculative; no paid purchase or repurchase is narrated. A15 considers returning Plasma Wash; completed remedy is unavailable. No explicit completed SS repurchase is established.

Engagement: all eight focal Junip records have 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes, observation time unavailable. Reddit native scores are A03=6, A17=7 and A18=10; all are supplied as material_positive=false/not_interpreted, with engagement observation time unavailable. No resonance promotion is warranted. Scores are not verified experiences, independence, prevalence or buying effects. Reddit accounts share one RegimenLab thread and have unavailable independence posture; retailer origins are credited as supplied. Source-account counts below are neither origin nor event counts.

Material context, outside focal counts: hillary_____k’s Level Serum comment (2025-01-16, score 24) reports a Black Friday purchase, brighter/even skin and emphatic intended repurchase, not completed repurchase or SS testimony. Skin_Fanatic (2025-01-17, score 2) asks about an alternative to untried C.R.E.A.M and expresses buying consideration. Engagement observation times are unavailable. The shared thread asks about RegimenLab; post actor and engagement are unavailable. context_f05862db0ee1dcb8c8c6 repeats A18 exactly and adds no origin or observation. Product/metadata contexts resolve references without donating experience. A14’s explicit gifted disclosure remains material despite metadata saying rewarded=false.
